title: Required front yards along district boundary located in a street

blocks.html: In the districts indicated, if the boundary of an adjoining Residence District is located at the center line of a street less than 60 feet wide, a front yard not higher than curb level and at least 20 feet in depth shall be provided along any front lot line forming the boundary between a zoning lot located within the Manufacturing District and that portion of the street in which the district boundary is located.
